caption: Wendy first appears in SSA data in 1918, fourteen years after Peter Pan opened. #Wendy #NameHistory #AIVoice
pinned_comment: What other name came from a book?
story_thesis: Wendy is absent from the record until 1918, fourteen years after Peter Pan opened, then rose to a 11,223 peak in 1967 and fell to 165 by 2025.
script: This name appears late in the record. Wendy first appears in 1918: five girls. Peter Pan opened in 1904. By 1967, Wendy reached 11,223. In 2025: 165. Watch the rise arrive slowly.
